# PintDownload — Free Pinterest Downloaders (Pin, Video, Board, Profile)

> PintDownload is a free online suite for downloading public Pinterest media: single pins (image/video/GIF/carousel), HD videos (MP4), board ZIPs, and profile ZIPs. No registration required. Private and secret content is not supported.

## Primary tools (distinct SEO intents)

- [Pinterest Pin Downloader](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-pin-downloader): Single pin URL → image, video, GIF, or full carousel slides.
- [Pinterest Video Downloader](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-video-downloader): Video pin → HD MP4 (and optional audio).
- [Pinterest Board Downloader](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-board-downloader): Board URL (`/username/board/`) → multi-pin ZIP.
- [Pinterest Profile Downloader](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-profile-downloader): Profile URL (`/username/`) → visible pins ZIP.
- [Pinterest Profile Picture Downloader](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-profile-picture-downloader): Public profile URL → HD avatar / PFP / DP (not a pin ZIP).
- [Pinterest Image Downloader](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-image-downloader): Still photos in the largest size Pinterest publishes (up to 1200 px wide).
- [Pinterest GIF Downloader](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-gif-downloader): Animated GIF pins.
- [Pinterest to MP4](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-to-mp4): Video pin link → downloadable MP4.
- [Pinterest Audio Downloader](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-audio-downloader): MP3 of a video pin's sound, encoded in the visitor's browser (192 kbps).

## MCP server (for AI assistants)

- Endpoint: `https://pintdownload.app/mcp` (remote MCP, Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only). Docs: [Pinterest MCP server](https://pintdownload.app/pinterest-mcp-server)
- Tools: `identify_pinterest_link`, `get_pinterest_pin_media`, `list_pinterest_board_pins`, `list_pinterest_profile_pins`, `get_pinterest_profile_picture`
- Public content only; results include download links, the source pin URL and creator for attribution.

## Languages

English lives at the site root. Localized versions are written for each language, not translated word for word from English, and live under a language prefix, such as `/es`; each page lists its versions with `hreflang`, and the sitemap repeats them. Released languages:

- English (en): https://pintdownload.app/
- Español (es): https://pintdownload.app/es
- Português (pt): https://pintdownload.app/pt
- Français (fr): https://pintdownload.app/fr
- Deutsch (de): https://pintdownload.app/de
- Italiano (it): https://pintdownload.app/it
- Nederlands (nl): https://pintdownload.app/nl
- Bahasa Indonesia (id): https://pintdownload.app/id
- Türkçe (tr): https://pintdownload.app/tr
- Tiếng Việt (vi): https://pintdownload.app/vi
- Русский (ru): https://pintdownload.app/ru
- ไทย (th): https://pintdownload.app/th
- العربية (ar): https://pintdownload.app/ar

## URL types

| URL shape | Tool |
|-----------|------|
| `pinterest.com/pin/…` or `pin.it/…` | Pin / Video / Image |
| `pinterest.com/username/board-name/` | Board ZIP |
| `pinterest.com/username/` | Profile ZIP or Profile Picture (avatar only) |

## API

- Programmatic access: use the MCP server above. `/api/extract` is the website's internal endpoint and rejects other origins.
